svg.title: Architecture of the head-sharing comparison
svg.desc: A frozen YOLO26n backbone and neck feed a common FP32 to FP16 to FP32 feature boundary. Its features fan out to three controlled rows with identical native adapter and predictor architectures. Only the second refiner F differs: native applies one F once; independent_k2 applies two distinct F objects in sequence, F1 then F2; shared_k2 applies the same F object twice. Each row stands for one of twelve sites: three scales, box or class, one-to-many or one-to-one. Nothing is tied across scales or branches.
